title: Ali and Ayse Work
text:
My name is Ali. I am a doctor. I work in a big hospital in Ankara. I help sick people every day.

My sister Ayse is a teacher. She works at a school near our house. She teaches English to children. She likes her job very much.

questions.text: How does Ayse probably feel about her job?
What can we say about Ali and Ayse?
options: They both help people through their work
They work only at night in a shop

vocabulary.definition: a place where doctors treat sick people
a person whose job is to teach
the work a person does to earn money

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Ben doktorum. Ankara'da büyük bir hastanede çalışıyorum. Her gün hasta insanlara yardım ediyorum.
Kız kardeşim Ayşe bir öğretmen. Evimizin yakınındaki bir okulda çalışıyor. Çocuklara İngilizce öğretiyor. İşini çok seviyor.
